findings.summary: Webhook deduplication keys only on X-GitHub-Delivery, but the HMAC authenticates only the raw body. A captured valid delivery can therefore be replayed with a fresh delivery header and will pass signature/event validation, be treated as new, and consume review/budget capacity. This does not provide the declared replay protection; bind replay detection to a signed-body digest (and coordinate/state freshness) in addition to, or instead of, the delivery header.
